tagline: A leading full-service transaction-processing business and financial technology provider in Latin America, Puerto Rico and the Caribbean
hero_kpi_rationale: The business model relies on multi-year contracts with mission-critical characteristics, generating high recurring revenue, which is the primary driver of predictability and profitability for EVTC.

kpis.name: Recurring Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenues from essential and contractually renewed services on a regular basis.
kpis.description: The majority of revenues come from critical services embedded in client operations, ensuring high recurrence.
kpis.signal: Resilient business model with strong recurring revenue

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total turnover generated by the company.
kpis.description: Growth driven by digital migration in Latin American markets.
kpis.signal: Moderate growth driven by electronic payments adoption

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit divided by total revenue.
kpis.description: Margin supported by controlled fixed costs and strong recurring revenue.
kpis.signal: High margin driven by operational efficiency and scalability

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending on material and technological investments.
kpis.description: Capex levels remain stable, reflecting a scalable model with limited heavy infrastructure requirements.
kpis.signal: Moderate Capex, consistent with a low capital intensity model

kpis.name: Headcount (Employees)
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the company.
kpis.description: Increase due to Tecnobank integration in Brazil and strengthening of technology teams.
kpis.signal: Headcount growth tied to regional expansion and acquisitions

kpis.name: Customer Concentration (Banco Popular)
kpis.explanation: Share of revenue from the main customer.
kpis.description: Banco Popular represents nearly one-third of revenues, with a contract in effect through 2028.
kpis.signal: Significant exposure to a single customer, key risk factor

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last six reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Total revenue of $0.454 billion in the most recent fiscal year (FY2018).

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Net income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last eight reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Net income of $0.142 billion in the most recent fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Brazil Expansion (Tecnobank Acquisition)
kpis.explanation: Acquisition of a majority stake in a key Brazilian fintech.
kpis.description: In October 2025, EVTC acquires 75% of Tecnobank, a major player in digital automotive financing in Brazil.
kpis.signal: Strategic strengthening of presence in Brazil

kpis.name: Share Repurchase Program
kpis.explanation: Amount authorized for the repurchase of own shares.
kpis.description: In July 2025, the board of directors approves a share repurchase program of $150 million through 2026.
kpis.signal: Strong commitment to shareholder value creation

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

risks.title: Dependence on Major Customer (Banco Popular)
risks.score_rationale: The risk is placed at the top of the 10-K, represents 29% of revenues, and uses strong language such as 'material adverse effect'. Contractual dependence through 2028 with uncertain renewal strengthens exposure. The Competition category is weighted as a contract termination would impact market position.

risks.title: Risk of Non-Renewal of Key Contracts
risks.score_rationale: Three major contracts (MSA, ISO, ATH) expire between 2028 and 2035. The document emphasizes uncertainty regarding renewal and the possibility of costly concessions. Repeated language on 'material adverse' impact on cash, debt and share price justifies maximum severity.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and Cyber Attacks
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned but without specific details in the provided source. While critical operations are exposed, the absence of detailed paragraphs on evolving threats (ransomware, AI, phishing) in the analyzed text justifies a severity of 4 rather than 5.

risks.title: Failure of Computer Systems
risks.score_rationale: The text emphasizes dependence on critical systems to process over ten billion transactions annually. Risks include outages, technical failures and disasters. The impact is characterized as potentially adverse, but mitigated by stable group operations.

risks.title: Dependence on Suppliers and Third Parties
risks.score_rationale: The text does not explicitly detail critical supplier dependencies. While risks are theoretical for a financial services company, the source does not provide specific alarming language.

risks.title: Regulatory Compliance and OFAC Sanctions
risks.score_rationale: The source explicitly mentions OFAC obligations and risks of violations of export regulations (EAR). Investor companies maintain restrictions for sanctioned countries, creating ongoing regulatory exposure.

risks.title: Competitive Position and Market Risks
risks.score_rationale: The source describes a fragmented, growing market with significant opportunities. EVERTEC holds a leading regional position. Competitive risk is present but mitigated by geographic diversification and multi-year contracts.

ai_positioning.summary: EVTC does not have significant mentions regarding artificial intelligence or machine learning in the provided excerpts.
